snippet.title: Dragonkin: The Banished | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Preorder Dragonkin: The Banished now and take the fight to the Dragon Lords!
 
In this action-ARPG, play solo, in local co-op (2-player) or any combination of up to 4 players online. Build your city, and your legacy as you tear through the Dragonkin, unlock new abilities, , and grab ever greater gear.
 
Train your wyrmling, define your playstyle with the Ancestral Grid, and clear out the Dragon Hordes in Dragonkin - The Banished. Coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC on March 19th.
